source_producer_and_meaning.implication: The nested INTENT(OUT) conditional producer makes the outer max(rhox,0) a read of a formally undefined element on the neither-active branch, despite the earlier zero initialization. This is a concrete rationale for removing the read. On producer-active cells, the density is bounded to [100,900]; the export writes zero when final qg<=qcrmin. These source facts alone do not establish runtime noninterference for all executions or toolchains.
